yagyopavit.title: Yagyopavit / Upanayana Muhurat 2026
yagyopavit.desc: The sacred thread ceremony (Upanayana or Yagyopavit) signifies the initiation of a student into education, spiritual practices, and moral responsibilities.

annaprashana.title: Annaprashana Muhurat 2026
annaprashana.desc: Annaprashana marks a baby's transition from liquids to solid food. Performing this ceremony during a Shubh Muhurat ensures excellent health and longevity.

vidyarambh.title: Vidyarambh Muhurat 2026
vidyarambh.desc: Vidyarambh marks the formal initiation of a child into the world of letters and learning, enhancing intellectual capacity and artistic capability.

namkaran.title: Namkaran Muhurat 2026
namkaran.desc: The naming ceremony (Namkaran) is one of the most vital rites of passage. Choosing a name under positive planetary configurations aligns identity with strength and luck.

vivah.title: Vivah Muhurat 2026
vivah.desc: Vivah Muhurat is selected with extreme care to ensure compatibility, longevity, happiness, and prosperity in a marriage.

mundan.title: Mundan Muhurat 2026
mundan.desc: Mundan (tonsure) cleanses past-life residues and stimulates excellent hair growth and intellectual development in children.

karnavedha.title: Karnavedha Muhurat 2026
karnavedha.desc: Karnavedha (ear piercing) stimulates vital acupressure points that enhance intellectual capabilities and sensory organs.
